title: DNA Barcoding Protocol
author: Jordan Beasley
materials: Aliquot 13.6µl PCR mastermix into each well.

Currently, ONTBarcoder software is used to extract consensus barcodes from the raw nanopore data. First fastq files from the run are concatenated into one fastq file containing all of the reads from the run. This file is loaded into ONTBarcoder as input along with a demultiplexing file containing the indexing information for each sample (see manual below for details). ONTBarcoder_manual.pdf ONTBarcoder can be downloaded here: https://github.com/asrivathsan/ONTbarcoder

steps.title: Spin down and inspect plate
steps.instruction: Spin down the sample plate, then inspect to ensure no tissue or sample is stuck in the sealing‑cap lids.

steps.title: Remove caps and ethanol
steps.instruction: Remove the caps, then aspirate and discard the ethanol using a single‑channel pipette for very small samples, taking care not to aspirate the sample itself.

steps.title: Evaporate residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Place the plate (no lid or seal) on an open‑lid thermocycler, set to 70 °C and run for at least 10 min (or longer until all ethanol has evaporated); handle the plate gently to avoid static‑induced sample loss.

steps.title: Prepare lysis master mix
steps.instruction: Using the KAPA Express Extract kit, combine per reaction: 44 µl molecular‑grade water, 1 µl 1 U/µl KAPA Express Extract enzyme, and 5 µl 10× KAPA Express Extract buffer to make a 50 µl lysis master mix (volume may be reduced for very small samples).

steps.title: Add lysis mix to wells
steps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µl of the lysis master mix into each well of the plate and seal with a clear PCR seal.

steps.title: Spin and incubate lysis
steps.instruction: Spin down the plate, then place on a thermocycler and run the following program: 30 °C for 30 min, 60 °C for 30 min, 95 °C for 5 min, then hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Dilute lysate 1:10
steps.instruction: Mix 2.5 µl of the lysate with 22.5 µl PCR‑grade water to obtain a 1:10 dilution (lysate may be stored at –20 °C until needed).

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For a 20 µl reaction, combine: 10.1 µl KAPA Plant PCR buffer (contains dNTPs), 2.9 µl PCR‑grade water, 0.2 µl polymerase, and 0.4 µl 25 mM MgCl₂ to make the PCR master mix (this amplifies a 750 bp COI amplicon with indexed ONT primers).

steps.title: Add primers and lysate
steps.instruction: To each well, add 1.6 µl indexed primer mix followed by 4.8 µl of the 1:10 diluted lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.6 µl indexed primer mix to each well.
Add 4.8 µl 1:10 diluted lysate to each well.

steps.title: Seal, mix and spin
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a PCR seal, briefly mix the contents, and spin the plate.

steps.title: Run PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a thermocycler and run: 1 cycle 95 °C 3 min; 5 cycles 95 °C 40 s, 45 °C 40 s, 72 °C 1 min; 40 cycles 95 °C 40 s, 65 °C 40 s, 72 °C 1 min; final 1 cycle 72 °C 5 min; hold at 4 °C indefinitely (plate may be stored at –20 °C).

steps.title: Prepare 1% agarose gel
steps.instruction: Pour 500 ml 1× TAE into a glass Duran bottle, add 5 g agarose powder, close the lid tightly and swirl to mix, then loosen the lid and microwave in short bursts until the solution boils and becomes clear; allow to cool to a molten but not hot state (enough for two large gels with 4 rows of 50‑well combs).

steps.title: Cast gel
steps.instruction: Tape the ends of a large gel tray, insert combs, then pour ~250 ml (half) of the molten agarose into the tray, avoiding bubbles; let the gel set firmly.

steps.title: Set up electrophoresis tank
steps.instruction: When the gel is solid, remove the combs and tape, place the gel in a tank filled with enough 1× TAE buffer to cover it.

steps.title: Prepare loading dye with Gel Red
steps.instruction: Add Gel Red to loading dye at a 1:1000 ratio.

steps.title: Load samples and run gel
steps.instruction: Mix 2 µl PCR product with 3 µl loading dye/Gel Red mix, load into wells alongside a 1 kb DNA ladder, run at 80 V for ~45 min, then visualize bands under a UV transilluminator.

steps.title: Pool PCR products
steps.instruction: Pool 5 µl of PCR product from each sample, ensuring that no two pooled samples share the same index.

steps.title: Quantify pool with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure the pooled DNA using a Qubit fluorometer by taking three 1 µl replicates, calculate the average ng/µl concentration.

steps.title: Prepare Nanopore sequencing library
steps.instruction: Using the Nanopore Ligation Sequencing kit V14, prepare a library with 500 ng DNA in a 24.5 µl reaction volume as described in the Flongle Library Prep Protocol; sequence on a Flongle (v10.4.1) for 24 h with super‑accurate basecalling.

steps.title: Identify species via BOLD
steps.instruction: Run ONTBarcoder, then query the resulting barcodes in BOLD using the BOLDigger tool to retrieve the top 20 hits for each barcode.
